facts.title: Old Mint card, discovery and trivia sit on the modern US Mint at 155 Hermann St, 2.26 km from the real Old Mint
facts.evidence: The old-mint card (places-history.json) is at 37.77013,-122.4274, and the matching places-discover and places-trivia entries use the same point (dist/assets/places-discover-*.js and places-trivia-*.js contain 37.77013). Nominatim for '155 Hermann Street' returns 'San Francisco Mint, 155 Hermann Street' at 37.7701866,-122.4274110, about 6 m from the card. That is the 1937 working federal mint. '88 5th Street' returns 'Old San Francisco Mint' at 37.7827368,-122.4072671, 2,257 m away. The card text describes the 1874 Granite Lady that survived 1906, and its source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_San_Francisco_Mint puts it at 5th and Mission. Players are sent to the wrong building.
facts.fix_hint: Move the at point to about 37.78274,-122.40727 (88 5th St) in the card, the discover entry and the trivia entry.

facts.title: SS Jeremiah O'Brien is described at Pier 45 in five places, but it has been at Pier 35 since 2023; the story waypoint is already at Pier 35 while its own text says Pier 45
facts.evidence: Pier 45 claims: the pier-45-ships card lore ('Two warriors share Pier 45... Nearby floats the SS Jeremiah O'Brien'), trivia-pier-45-ships ('Which two historic vessels are at Pier 45?... USS Pampanito and SS Jeremiah O'Brien'), the tour-fishermans-wharf stop, the discover blurb, and story chapter 6 objective in quest-escape-velocity: 'Salute the old Liberty ship tied up at Pier 45.' That objective's waypoint is 37.80876,-122.40686, and Nominatim puts 'SS Jeremiah O'Brien' at 37.8087594,-122.4068649 (0 m) and 'Pier 35' 44 m away, about 850 m from Pier 45. USS Pampanito geocodes to Pier 45, 5 m from the card. Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SS_Jeremiah_O%27Brien: 'Docked at Pier 35' and, after the 2020 fire, the nonprofit 'signed a long-term lease at Pier 35 with the Port of San Francisco' (2023). The card cites this page. The text ships in dist ('Two warriors share Pier 45').
facts.fix_hint: Make the card about Pampanito at Pier 45 with the O'Brien a short hop east at Pier 35. Fix the trivia question and answer, the tour line and the story objective text to say Pier 35.

facts.title: GitHub HQ is presented as active (Oval Office lobby, hack nights there), but GitHub announced its permanent closure in Feb 2023
facts.evidence: The github card and tech-discover blurb say 'Home of the world's code, with an Oval Office in the lobby.' tech-hacks.json hack-github: venue 'GitHub HQ', 'Builder groups host evening hack nights under the Oval Office replica.' (in dist). SF Standard, 2023-02-10, https://sfstandard.com/2023/02/10/san-francisco-silicon-vally-tech-layoffs-closes-sf-office : GitHub 'said Thursday it would close its headquarters near Brannan and Second streets', 'shutting down all its offices'. The Real Deal headline: 'GitHub to exit South Beach headquarters' (https://therealdeal.com/sanfrancisco/2023/02/10/github-to-exit-south-beach-headquarters). https://nayafia.substack.com/p/remembering-githubs-office : 'GitHub's February announcement that it would permanently close its San Francisco headquarters.' I found no report of it reopening. I could not pin the exact move-out date.
facts.fix_hint: Rewrite as history ('GitHub's former HQ, closed after 2023, had an Oval Office lobby'). Retire or re-theme the GitHub HQ hack night, or move it to a venue that still operates.

facts.title: Alcatraz card says the island has the oldest operating lighthouse on the West Coast; the current tower is from 1909 and Point Pinos (1855) holds that title
facts.evidence: The alcatraz card in places-landmarks.json has the fact 'The island has the oldest operating lighthouse on the West Coast.' (in dist). The game's own quest-occupation-of-alcatraz card says 'The first lighthouse on the US West Coast was lit on Alcatraz in 1854; today's tower replaced it in 1909.' https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alcatraz_Island_Lighthouse : the current light is a 'concrete tower built in 1909' that replaced the 1854 original. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_Pinos_Lighthouse : lit February 1, 1855, 'the oldest continuously operating lighthouse on the West Coast'. The card copies an unsupported line from the Alcatraz Island lead.
facts.fix_hint: Change to 'The island was the site of the West Coast's first lighthouse, lit in 1854.'

facts.title: Swensen's 'See Us Freeze' neon sign 'still glows' in three places; the real sign reads 'The Original Swensen's Since 1948'
facts.evidence: The swensens card lore says 'Its first name was See Us Freeze, and the red neon sign with that name still glows in the window.' trivia-swensens explain: 'The red See Us Freeze neon sign still glows in the window.' The tour-russian-hill stop: 'The See Us Freeze sign still glows.' (in dist). The card's own source, https://sfstandard.com/2023/05/31/swensons-ice-cream-san-francisco-origin-story-legacy-status/ , shows a vintage neon sign that 'reads The Original Swensen's Since 1948' and mentions See Us Freeze only as the 1948 business name that Earle later changed.
facts.fix_hint: Keep the See Us Freeze name history. Say the neon reads 'The Original Swensen's Since 1948'.

facts.title: Wharf scavenger hunt ends at the Cartoon Art Museum, which closed on August 2, 2026
facts.evidence: In quest-scavenger.json, scavenger-fishermans-wharf has the blurb 'Six notes along the wharf, from the sea lions to the cartoon museum.' Its last token is name 'Cartoon Art Museum' at 37.80638,-122.42179. The name shows in the pickup toast (src/activities/kinds/scavenger.ts:75 'Note n/6 · <name>'), and the token ships in dist ('"name":"Cartoon Art Museum"'). The museum's press release, https://cartoonart.org/press-releases/2026/7/31/cartoon-art-museum-update-closing-a-chapter : 'our current location will close on Sunday, August 2, 2026'. No new location is announced.
facts.fix_hint: Swap the last token for a stop that is still open (Hyde Street Pier or Ghirardelli Square) and update the blurb.

facts.title: Japanese Tea Garden card says about 3 acres; the garden says about 5
facts.evidence: The japanese-tea-garden card in places-parks.json says 'It covers about 3 acres in Golden Gate Park.' The garden's official site, https://www.japaneseteagardensf.com/about , says it was 'expanded the garden to its current size of approximately 5 acres'. The Wikipedia infobox also gives 5 acres; the 3-acre figure is an inconsistent line in the Wikipedia body.
facts.fix_hint: Change to 'about 5 acres' and cite japaneseteagardensf.com.

net.title: Silent eavesdropper: a peer that never says hi gets your mic, live position and chat but never appears in the room
net.evidence: eavesdrop.mjs (?test&net=local&room=QZ7KM, fake mic). A raw BroadcastChannel peer posted only {k:'hello'}. Within 3 s it received {hi:1, st:37, chat:1}, including the victim's chat text and 12 Hz positions with m:1 (mic on). The victim's wrapped transport.addStream was called with {to:'eavesdropper', tracks:1}. The victim saw net.visiblePeers().length 0, no 'joined' toast and an empty chip, and the Friends panel said 'Looking for your friends...' (eavesdrop-victim.png). Cause: session.ts send() (line 250) sends to every non-blocked peer, and peerJoin() (lines 282-283) does sayHi plus addStream(mic) for peers with known=false; only the UI filters on known.
net.fix_hint: Send st/chat/ping/match messages and add the mic stream only to peers with known=true. Start streaming a peer once its first valid hi arrives. Optionally list connecting but unannounced peers in the roster.

net.title: Room codes can be recovered from public relay traffic in under a minute, so strangers can join any active room
net.evidence: Trystero 0.26 publishes each room as a nostr event tagged x = sha1('Trystero@fly-around-sf@room-CODE') (core strategy.mjs:39-40, nostr index.mjs createEvent tags [["x", topic]]). The handshake key is genKey(password ?? '', appId, roomId), and p2p.ts:7 sets no password. sniff.mjs subscribed to the 29 default relays with only {since} (no topic filter) while the game sat in room Q9V75, and saw the victim's topic on 6 relays (relay.aarpia.com, nos.lol, ...). crack-room.mjs reversed a random topic to its code (W74EY) in 28.5 s on one core; the full 32^5 space takes about 44 s. Device-sync rooms use the same scheme with 8-character codes (40 bits, minutes on a GPU), and their claim secret is code.slice(4), which anyone able to join already knows (sync.ts:97-98). Combined with the silent-peer bug, anyone can listen in on any room unseen.
net.file_hint: src/net/protocol.ts makeCode / src/net/session.ts:135 create() / src/net/p2p.ts:7 joinRoom / src/net/sync.ts:97-98
net.fix_hint: Give rooms a high-entropy secret, at least 80 bits, carried in the share link (for example in the URL fragment) and pass it as Trystero's password, or use long room ids. Typed 5-character codes should not be the only protection. Do the same for sync codes.

net.title: Lookalike (homoglyph) names get past the duplicate-name suffix, so a peer can pose as another pilot in chat
net.evidence: homoglyph.mjs: victim 'Pilot-1878' #f2f2ee. A raw peer sending hi with the exact name was shown as 'Pilot-1878 (copy)', as the earlier fix intends. A second peer using Cyrillic Р and і ('Ріlot-1878', same color) was shown unsuffixed, got the toast 'Ріlot-1878 joined the room', and its chat line 'I am leaving, here is my home address' rendered as from 'Ріlot-1878', identical on screen to the victim. session.ts:318 compares names with ===.
net.fix_hint: Compare a confusable skeleton (NFKC, lowercased, mapped to Latin) instead of the raw string, or limit pilot names to one script.

net.title: Stale 1.5 s close timer from a finished sync kills the next sync offer, which then waits 10 minutes for nobody
net.evidence: sync-stale-timer.mjs: A offered and B received, so A reached 'sent'. A pressed Send again at once and got code BHFXV2AF. 2.5 s later A showed {phase:'waiting', code:'BHFXV2AF', transportOpen:false}. B entering that code stayed 'receiving' (still so after 5 s; it expires at 10 minutes). The untracked setTimeout(() => this.close(), 1500) at sync.ts:156 (and the receiver's at :194) closes whatever transport is current.
net.fix_hint: Capture the transport in the timeout and close only that one (const t = this.t; setTimeout(() => { if (this.t === t) this.close(); }, 1500)), or track the timeout and clear it in stop().

net.title: Still broken: a blocked player is unblocked by simply reloading their tab (gets your mic, position and chat again)
net.evidence: s5.mjs over real relays. A blocked B through the Friends panel Block button: A then had visible=[], chat=[], voice chains=0. B reloaded its page. 9.7 s after the reload A listed 'Ebiqn5 Pilot-5131 blocked=false', fired net:join with a 'Pilot-5131 joined the room' toast, received B's chat 'B after reload', and attached B's audio (chainsWithSource=[Ebiqn5]). B saw A again (bSees=['Pilot-5833']). Cause: setBlocked and the past map in src/net/session.ts are keyed by the Trystero peer id, and src/net/p2p.ts uses Trystero's selfId, which is random on every page load. The fix 'Keep a blocked or reconnecting peer's identity for the whole session' therefore only covers same-tab reconnects.
net.fix_hint: Send a stable per-install id in the 'hi' message, generated once and stored with the save. Keep the blocked set keyed by that id, and by name+color as a fallback, for the session or persisted. When a hi arrives from a blocked id, mark the peer blocked before greeting, and skip addStream and position sends to it.

net.title: Friends farther than 3 km vanish completely: no tag, no ping label, nothing on map or minimap, and 'Fly to' points at a stale spot
net.evidence: s13.mjs with the friend 4.06 km away: the room chip said 'FNFKB6 · 1 friend' but the .net-tag was hidden (s13-b-far.png), and the Map panel had no friend marker (s13-b-map.png, mapHasFriend=false). s16.mjs: a friend's ping at 2.5 km showed an edge label, but at 3.5 km both the ping label and the tag were hidden even though net.pings.size=1. Cause: view.ts place() hides anything with d > TAG_RANGE (3000), even with pinEdge. src/ui/panels/map.ts, minimap.ts and nearby.ts never read game.net, and nothing emits 'net:ping-request', so the 'ping from the map' path in ARCHITECTURE.md is dead. 'Fly to' copies p.pos once (friends.ts:202): after the friend moved, the waypoint stayed at (2341,-1139) while the friend was at (-1658,-2339).
net.fix_hint: Keep edge-pinned tags and ping labels beyond TAG_RANGE (faded, with distance). Draw friend dots and pings in their color on the minimap and Map, and let a map tap emit net:ping-request. Make 'Fly to' follow the live peer position (refresh the waypoint from net.peers each frame while it targets that peer).

net.title: All players spawn at one point in the same default white: friends appear inside your drone and their name tags stack
net.evidence: Every non-?spawn player starts at SPAWN (src/game.ts:38,185) and droneColor defaults to '#f2f2ee' for everyone. In s2 (3 peers), C's chip read '2 friends' but only one tag, 'Pilot-6445 0 m', was visible over C's own drone, because both remote tags sat on the same pixel (s2-c-three.png). In s4, the friend who joined from the real share link saw 'Pilot-5059 1 m' hovering over their own drone, with the host's drone inside it (s4-b-joined.png). In s1 both pilots were white drones with white tag dots.
net.file_hint: src/game.ts (spawn), src/net/session.ts peerJoin, src/ui/settings-model.ts (defaults), src/net/view.ts place()
net.fix_hint: When joining a room, spawn the joiner a few meters off (ring offset by id hash) or next to the host. Pick a random default drone color from the swatches for new pilots. Nudge overlapping name tags apart vertically.

net.title: Drone tag starts with a free tag and then ping-pongs IT when players are together at go
net.evidence: s15.mjs: A started tag (duration 20, A is IT) while both pilots were at spawn, and B joined from the invite. At the instant the phase turned 'live' (14 s), IT had already switched to B. With A hovering 3 m from an idle B, IT then changed 6 times in 16 s (roles 14s B, 20s A, 24s B, 28s A...). Both sides got repeated 'Pilot-3867 tagged you. You are IT!' toasts. modes.ts tick() claims the nearest player within TAG_RADIUS 8 m as soon as t - lastTag >= TAG_COOLDOWN 3, and enter() spreads players only for races, so friends who start a match side by side always open with an instant tag.
net.fix_hint: At go, give runners a head start: IT cannot tag for the first ~5 s of 'live' and is shown frozen or with a countdown. Or teleport the roster apart at enter() the way race does. A longer per-pair tag-back cooldown would stop the ping-pong.

net.title: No TURN relay: peers whose networks block direct UDP can never connect
net.evidence: The built p2p chunk (dist/assets/p2p-DYqYhPIf.js) lists ICE servers as only stun:stun.l.google.com, stun1, stun2 and stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478, with no turn: or turns: entry. src/net/p2p.ts passes no rtcConfig or turnConfig to joinRoom (grep for iceServers/turnConfig/rtcConfig in src returns nothing). The app already admits this failure mode with the toast 'A friend could not connect directly. Their network may block peer to peer.' after JOIN_GRACE_MS. Phones and iPads are a stated target. I could not reproduce a NAT failure here because both contexts ran on one host and connected via host candidates; this finding rests on the config.
net.fix_hint: Pass a turnConfig to joinRoom (e.g. a free or low-cost TURN such as Cloudflare Calls or metered.ca credentials issued by the existing Cloudflare worker proxy). Then say in the friends panel when a peer is connected through a relay.

flight.title: Gamepad A, Y, Back, Start and D-pad never fire: no interact, map, journal or menu, and Start cannot close a panel
flight.evidence: gamepad.mjs with a fake standard gamepad through Navigator.prototype.getGamepads, ?test&cityRadius=3000, next to pitch-founders-inc. Start(9), Y(3), Back(8) and A(0) each gave openId null and active null, while keyboard F at the same spot started pitch-founders-inc. With the menu opened by Esc, Start(9) left openId 'menu'. Cause: gamepad buttons are only read in Input.gamepad(), called from flight() (input.ts:77-98), which game.step calls after handleActions() (game.ts:258-260) and not at all while a panel is open. clearPressed() (game.ts:274) then wipes them before the next handleActions. Only actions a system consumes mid-step (LB ping, X photo) work. This breaks R-INPUT and the README's 'Gamepads ... work too'.
flight.fix_hint: Read the gamepad once at the start of step, before handleActions, whether or not a panel is open. Keep flight() for axes only, so button edges reach handleActions and the panel toggles.

flight.title: Chase camera has no occlusion handling: near tall buildings it jumps onto a rooftop, giving a top-down or solid-gray view
flight.evidence: Probe c/perch_a_street.png then c/perch_b_turned.png: the drone flies at 22 m down Montgomery St and turns 90 degrees in 12 steps of 0.1 s. The camera ends at y=75 (groundAt under it = 75) while the drone is at y=22: the view snaps to straight down and the way ahead is lost. Teleport view at 37.7895,-122.4010 (a/noon_street.png): the whole frame is flat roof gray and the drone is not visible. camera.ts:41 only does desired.y = max(desired.y, groundAt(camera x,z) + 2). groundAt includes roofAt, so the camera hops onto whatever roof is 15 m behind, with no line-of-sight or pull-in, and lerps through walls on the way.
flight.fix_hint: Replace the roof clamp with a pull-in: march from the drone toward the desired camera position and stop just before the first sample where world.collide or groundAt is above the ray, shortening distance instead of raising height. Keep the ground clamp only for terrain.

flight.title: Edge-pinned ping label overlaps the camera button on the right edge
flight.evidence: s1-b-ping-chat.png at 1100x700: a friend's ping 339 m away, off-screen to the right, is pinned at the right edge as '📍 Pilot-1951 339 m', drawn over the round 📷 photo button at about x=1065, y=350. view.ts place() clamps edge labels only to EDGE=28 px from the viewport edge and BOTTOM_EDGE, and knows nothing about the HUD buttons on the right side.
flight.fix_hint: Keep edge labels out of the right-side button column (a larger right inset, or avoid the photo button's rect), or put the pinned label inside the screen edge with an arrow instead of over the controls.

objective.title: Device sync still drops the in-progress story chapter (quest:* flags), so the other device restarts the chapter
objective.evidence: The earlier 'sync drops progress flags' bug is still broken on this build for quest flags. sync-flags.mjs (two pages, ?net=local): device A had flags {'quest:quest-git-blame': 3, onboarded: true} and completed quest-initial-commit. Device B, after the merge (phase 'merged'), had flags {} with the completion carried over. cleanSave (sync.ts:66-77) whitelists only COUNTERS, medal:, points: and daily, so the quest:<id> objective index that quest.ts:71/101 reads and writes is discarded.
objective.fix_hint: In cleanSave, keep quest:<id> when id is a known quest activity and the value is an integer from 0 to below that quest's objectives.length. mergeSaves can keep the larger index.

objective.title: Corrupt saved stats are trusted: a string stat grows every frame, unlocks achievements early and can eventually fill localStorage
objective.evidence: corrupt.mjs seeded the save with stats.distance '1200' (a string). After 1 s of ?test flight it was a 575-character string ('12000.3056609018657...'), which my estimate puts at about 1.1 KB/s at 60 steps/s, so the 5 MB quota fills in about 75 minutes and persist() then fails silently (save.ts catch). The stats panel showed 'NaN km', and string comparison awarded 'First Kilometer' after about 10 m of flight. XP went from 40 to 350, though part of that came from an activity and achievements completed at spawn. normalize() (save.ts:19-36) spreads r.stats, best, completed and pos without type checks; game.ts loads pos into teleport() the same way.
objective.fix_hint: In normalize, keep only finite numbers for stats, best and completed values and a 4-number pos, falling back to defaults otherwise. Reuse the clamp helper that cleanSave already has.

objective.title: 115 timed reading activities (trivia, pitch) cannot be paused or extended; the trivia clock keeps running while Esc/Menu, Controls or Settings is open, then locks the player out for 60 s
objective.evidence: Content has 102 trivia activities (30 s limit, src/activities/kinds/trivia.ts DEFAULT_LIMIT) and 13 pitch meetings (20 s rounds, PITCH.roundTime in src/activities/kinds/pitch.ts). Neither has a setting to extend or disable the limit (WCAG 2.2.1, Level A). src/game.ts:259-272 runs activities.update(dt) even when panels.openId is set, and the trivia digit handler ignores keys while a panel is open (places-views.ts onKey). Repro (.review/a11y/r3/pause.mjs): start trivia-coit-tower trivia, press Escape (opens the Menu sheet; there is no other pause), open 'help' (Controls), step 31 s. Result text is "Time's up. Answer: Lillie Hitchcock Coit", and restarting gives the toast 'Coit Tower Trivia: try again in 57s'. Story dialogue pauses on panel:open (quest-dialogue.ts:77) but trivia does not. At 200% zoom (640x400 at DPR 2) the 4th trivia answer sits below the fold (rect bottom 420 > 400; .review/a11y/r3/zoom-trivia.png), and the player must scroll while the clock runs. This differs from the fixed 'card pop-up covers trivia' item: no pop-up is involved.
objective.fix_hint: Skip activities.update (or freeze the timed instance's clock) while panels.openId is set, as quest-dialogue already does. Add one 'Relaxed timers' setting (for example x2 or off) read by trivia and pitch.

objective.title: Story dialogue auto-advances every 3.5 to 12 s; only mouse hover pauses it, and missed lines cannot be re-read
objective.evidence: quest-dialogue.ts:126 sets hold = min(12, max(3.5, 1.5 + len/20)) s after typing at 48 chars/s. tick() only skips the countdown when this.hover is true, and hover is set by pointerenter/pointerleave only (lines 67-68). Keyboard focus and touch never pause it. Measured (.review/a11y/r3/timed.mjs): started quest-initial-commit, focused the .qd-next button with the keyboard and gave no input; Norton's 210-character line 1/4 advanced to 2/4 at 18.6 s by itself. The Quest Log panel (src/ui/panels/quests.ts) has no transcript of past lines, so a slow reader or anyone who looks away loses the mystery spine's text. This fails WCAG 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 for the core story.
objective.fix_hint: Do not auto-advance (F/Next already advances), or pause on focusin as well as hover and honour a relaxed-timers setting. Append shown lines to the quest's Quest Log entry.

objective.title: Spawn awards an unearned card and achievements at second 0, burying the tutorial's first instruction
objective.evidence: r3c.mjs fresh save, sim 0.2 s after pressing Start with no input: completed = discover-founders-inc, achievement-cards-1, achievement-done-1. The observer logged the toast 'Founders, Inc. +20 XP', the 'First Card' banner, the 'Off the Ground: Complete your first activity' banner and a full-screen 'NEW RARE CARD Founders, Inc.' reveal, all at 0.2 s. In the real-time run (r3a.mjs, night) 'Night Owl' and 'Level 2 pilot' also fired in the same burst: five notifications at once. Screenshots r3c-00-start.png and r3-03-first-view.png show the dimmed reveal with the 'Step 1 of 6: Fly forward' card hidden (opacity 0 under .revealing). The spawn sits inside the Founders, Inc. discovery radius, so 'Off the Ground' is granted before the drone has moved. This follows the fixed 'awarded invisibly behind the title' issue: the awards now show, but they land on top of step 1 of the tutorial.
objective.file_hint: src/game.ts SPAWN (37.8066,-122.4318); src/content/activities/tech-discover.json (discover-founders-inc radius); achievement-done-1 in src/content/activities/achievements.json
objective.fix_hint: Move SPAWN outside the Founders, Inc. discovery radius, or hold passive discoveries and achievements until tutorial step 1 is met. Do not count passive discoveries toward 'Complete your first activity'.

objective.title: 'Tutorial complete' card overlaps Norton's opening dialogue and tells the player to press L for the chapter they just started
objective.evidence: r3d.mjs: finish the tutorial by following its waypoint to 'Initial Commit' and pressing F. The visible rects at that moment are .onboard 430,574-850,692 ('TUTORIAL COMPLETE / You are cleared for takeoff / Press L for The Lost Commit: Emperor Norton needs a pilot...') and .qd 310,553-970,700 ('EMPEROR NORTON / Halt, citizen!...'). Screenshot r3d-01-chapter-started.png shows the takeoff text bleeding through the glass of Norton's dialogue box. Step 6 points every tutorial finisher at Chapter 1, so everyone who completes the tutorial sees this. The message sends them to the Quest Log for a story that is already playing.
objective.file_hint: src/ui/onboarding.ts stop(true) (done card, 3.8 s timeout); src/ui/ui.css:120 .onboard bottom position
objective.fix_hint: When the activity that ends the tutorial is a quest chapter, skip the takeoff card or show it after the dialogue closes, with copy that does not point to L. Or move the card away from the dialogue slot.

objective.title: A paused or reloaded chapter shows as 'Ready / press F to begin', and Continue gives no pointer back to it
objective.evidence: r3i.mjs seeded a real save with Chapter 1 at objective index 2 (2 of 4 done, flag quest:quest-initial-commit=2) and the drone at Crissy Field. Loading the non-test build and pressing Continue (title read 'Continue / Pilot-3077 · Level 2 · 5 done') gave no tracker, no .hud-status and no waypoint. Quest Log text: '0 of 12 chapters restored / 1 / Initial Commit / Ready / Marina · 3.2 km · 120 XP ... Fly to the beacon and press F to begin.' panels/quests.ts:61-76 shows 'In progress' and the objective list only when active?.def.id matches, so the saved objective index is never shown. The 'Abandon chapter' path has the same gap: it toasts 'Chapter paused. Start it again any time.' but the log then shows the same 'Ready ... begin'.
objective.fix_hint: In the Quest Log, read game.save.data.flags[`quest:${id}`]: show 'Paused 2/4', tick off the finished objectives and label the action 'Resume'. On Continue with a paused chapter, set the waypoint to its start beacon.

objective.title: 'Skip tutorial' removes the only pointer to Chapter 1 and the mystery
objective.evidence: r3h.mjs: Start, close the reveal, click .onboard-skip. Afterwards game.waypoint is null, there is no toast and the tutorial card is gone. The only guidance on screen is the F prompt for 'Pitch Founders, Inc. ... 1 of 2 here · C next' (screenshot r3h-00-after-skip.png). The 'Press L for The Lost Commit' line exists only in onboarding.ts stop(true), and step 6's waypoint to firstActivity() is set only when step 6 is reached. Players who skip, likely experienced ones, are never told the story spine exists.
objective.fix_hint: On skip, run the same hand-off as on completion: set the waypoint to firstActivity(game) and show a short 'Press L for The Lost Commit' toast.

objective.title: Final mystery objective says 'top of the Ferry Building clock tower' but its target is inside the building 67 m lower; the Chapter 6 Alcatraz shard is likewise inside the lighthouse
objective.evidence: ch12 obj5 (find, radius 16, alt 8): the target resolves to y=10.5 with groundAt 2.5, and world.collide(target,1.2)=true. The clock-tower collider top is 67 m above the target (landmark TOP=77). ferry.mjs: hovering at the tower top is 70.7 m from the target with idx unchanged, and circling the tower top at radius 12 m and heights 60/66/72 m never triggered. The only free space within 16 m is about 10 to 12 m away on the main roof near the tower base. In story.txt the autopilot needed 99 s and triggered at 14.6 m. ferry-tower.png shows only a guide arrow pointing down into the roof. Chapter 6 obj2 ('near the Alcatraz lighthouse. Search the island's crown'): the target collides, and approaching from above stalled 22.1 m away (radius 12) at (680,68,-6521) until forced. Root cause: quest.ts objectivePoints() uses game.world.point(), whose groundAt ignores hand-built landmarks, while scavenger.ts was fixed to use minigame spot() (which lifts out of colliders). ARCHITECTURE.md says landmark activity points must sit above TOP.
objective.file_hint: src/activities/kinds/quest.ts objectivePoints(); src/content/activities/quest-story.json (quest-force-push obj5, quest-escape-velocity obj2)
objective.fix_hint: Build find/collect points with spot() from minigame.ts as scavenger does, and set the Ferry Building objective alt above TOP 77 so the text and the target agree.

objective.title: Chapter start points share the 45 m start radius with side activities, so F at the chapter waypoint can start a chase or trivia instead
objective.evidence: 9 of 12 chapter starts have another startable activity 26 to 44 m away, inside START_RADIUS 45: ch4 collect-chinatown-fortune-cookies@26m and trivia-portsmouth-square@31m; ch5 tour-north-beach@28m; ch6 chase-pier-39-seagull@26m; ch7 trivia-cable-car-museum@41m; ch8 trivia-lottas-fountain@39m; ch9 trivia-mission-dolores@27m and tour-mission-murals@34m; ch11 trivia-cliff-house@35m and trivia-camera-obscura@35m; ch12 photo-skyline-from-twin-peaks@44m. runner.update() sorts nearbyList by done, then distance only. In story.txt, arriving from the previous chapter within 30 m of the start gave nearbyAtStart ['chase-pier-39-seagull','quest-escape-velocity'] for ch6 and ['trivia-cliff-house','quest-edge-of-the-map'] for ch11, so the prompt and F pick the side activity, not the chapter the 'Next: Chapter N. Waypoint set.' toast led to. This is not the earlier 'stacked on top of each other' report: starts are now 26 m or more apart, but the story chapter still loses priority.
objective.file_hint: src/activities/runner.ts update() nearbyList sort; src/systems/quests.ts questWaypoint
objective.fix_hint: When a quest waypoint is active, sort the chapter it points at first in nearbyList, or move side activities more than 45 m from chapter starts.

objective.title: Chase medals depend on spawn luck: the 'fastest bird alive' was caught for gold in 2.5 s in one run and took 91 s in another
objective.evidence: chase.ts spawns the bird at home plus (+/-40, +10, -50..-90), north of the start, and it wanders toward random goals until spooked. play.txt: chase-fidi-peregrine (speed 36, gold 25 s) arrived from the east, the bird started 98 m away and was caught in 2.4 s ('caught in 2.5s', medal 3). focus.txt: the same chase started from the activity point facing north took 91.4 s. Other chases took 8.6 to 32.6 s against a 15 s gold. The outcome depends on approach direction and spawn offset more than on skill.
objective.file_hint: src/activities/kinds/chase.ts start() bird spawn and wander
objective.fix_hint: Spawn the bird a fixed distance ahead of the player's position when the chase starts, so the opening gap is the same every time.

objective.title: Story 'find' clues 1.5 to 2.3 km away have no waypoint, no map marker and no hints (Chapter 2 Inspiration Point, Chapter 10 Hippie Hill)
objective.evidence: quest.ts begin() calls guide(game, null) for find objectives, so game.waypoint becomes null. markers() reveals the shard only within REVEAL=160 m, and the find radius is 12 m in 3D. Unlike riddles (HINT_TIMES 60/120 s, the second hint names the place), find objectives get no hints. Measured distance from the previous objective point: ch2 obj4 Inspiration Point 2248 m, ch10 obj2 Hippie Hill 1470 m, ch1 obj2 Wave Organ 949 m. No non-quest activity or map marker is titled 'Inspiration Point' or 'Hippie Hill' (search over all activity JSON), so the map cannot help. In-browser at the start of ch2 obj4 (find.mjs): {waypoint:null, markers:[], distToShard:2254}, and the tracker shows only 'somewhere around Inspiration Point, the overlook above the Presidio forest. Search the trees.' Screenshot .review/gameplay/r3/find-ch2-hud.png shows no compass pip, guide arrow or edge label. In story.txt every find objective logs waypoint:null.
objective.fix_hint: Give find objectives the riddle hint ladder: after 60 s set a waypoint or map ring to the area, and after 120 s point at the shard. Or raise REVEAL for find objectives that start far away.

ui.title: Share link with an invalid ?room= shows the raw text on the title's Join button, then silently drops the player into solo play
ui.evidence: badroom.mjs: ?test&title&net=local&room=MEET-AT-PIER-39-B0AT. The primary title button read 'Join friends / Room MEET-AT-PIER-39-B0AT' (badroom-title.png); title.ts:159 shows room.slice(0,24) without normalizing it. After clicking Join, net.room was null and status 'off', with no warning toast (only XP toasts). ui/index.ts:42 ignores the false returned by net.join. A mistyped or garbled link (0 for O, a truncated code) fails the same silent way, and any text can be placed on the official title screen.
ui.fix_hint: Run normalizeCode(opts.room) before showing the button. If it is null, show 'This room link is not valid' and offer solo play or the Join form, and toast when join() returns false.

ui.title: Ask the City sheet leaks keyboard focus to HUD controls behind the modal via the 'Live guide (optional)' summary
ui.evidence: Keyboard only, no ?test (.review/a11y/r3/kbd2.mjs). Open Ask the City with Enter on its menubar button, then Tab: input, Ask, 3 chips, summary 'Live guide (optional)', then BODY, then button.minimap 'Open the map' (sheet=false), then button.onboard-skip 'Skip tutorial' (sheet=false), then back to Close. The full kbd.mjs sweep counted 3 escapes for ask and 0 for every other panel. Cause: trapTab in src/ui/panel-host.ts uses FOCUSABLE = 'button:not([disabled]), [href], input..., [tabindex]...', which omits summary. The inputs inside the closed <details> are filtered out (offsetParent null), so the trap thinks 'What is Aquatic Park?' is the last stop and lets Tab run past the summary out of an aria-modal dialog.
ui.fix_hint: Add 'summary' to FOCUSABLE. Better: set inert on game.ui siblings of the sheet while it is open, which removes the hand-written trap entirely.

ui.title: aria-live HUD status re-announces a running clock about 10 times a second during almost every activity
ui.evidence: src/ui/hud.ts:37 makes .hud-status aria-live=polite, and hud.ts:86 writes a.inst.hud() into it whenever the HUD key changes (speed, altitude, heading, battery, hud text). Almost every kind puts a ticking value in hud(): rings `${t.toFixed(1)}s`, hover 'hold x.x/10s · 137.5 of 4 m · 0:59 left', chase, collect, riddle, scavenger, ride-along 'catch up! x.xs', trivia 'Ns', hack. Measured with .review/a11y/r3/live2.mjs on rings-marina-warmup: 3 s of sim with per-frame HUD updates produced 31 MutationObserver records and 31 distinct texts ('Marina Warmup  0/5  0.0s', '0.1s', ... '3.0s'). A screen reader queues every one, so the speech channel is flooded and real status messages are drowned out.
ui.fix_hint: Remove aria-live from .hud-status (keep it visual). Announce only discrete changes (ring 2/5, done or failed) through the existing toasts region, which already speaks.

ui.title: Trivia question pops up as a non-modal dialog that is neither focused nor announced, so screen-reader players hear only a countdown
ui.evidence: Started trivia-golden-gate-bridge (.review/a11y/r3/timed.mjs). The .trivia root is role=dialog with no aria-modal. document.activeElement stays BODY. The question h3 has no aria-live/status/alert ancestor (qLive: 'none'). Aria snapshot: dialog 'When did the Golden Gate Bridge open to the public?' with 4 buttons, but nothing moves focus there or announces it. The only spoken output is the aria-live .hud-status 'Golden Gate Bridge Trivia 30s', '29s', ... while the 30 s timer is a bare bar with only title='30 seconds' (src/ui/places-views.ts:36-40). The result text is aria-live, so the player learns they ran out of time but never hears the question.
ui.fix_hint: Focus the first option (or the dialog) on open, and/or put the question in the existing polite result region when shown. Expose remaining time once, for example at 10 s left, not as a ticking string.

ui.title: Small HUD and title labels drawn over the 3D scene measure about 3.4:1 (title 'Pilot name' 2.9:1), below 4.5:1
ui.evidence: Pixel measurement at noon (?time=2026-10-19T20:00:00Z, .review/a11y/r3/contrast.mjs, screenshot contrast-hud-S.png), 98th-percentile text luminance vs median background: .hud-stat span 'SPD' (10px, --ink-dim) 3.43 to 3.50:1 over three headings; .hud-stat small 'km/h' (11px) 3.68 to 3.76:1; title .title-field > span 'Pilot name' (11px) 2.89:1. Theory agrees: rgba(246,243,236,0.66) on --glass rgba(18,24,32,0.58) over the light-gray ground comes to about 3.6:1. Axe cannot check these because the background is a canvas, so they pass CI unseen.
ui.fix_hint: Use solid --ink (or about 0.85 alpha) for these 10 to 11 px labels, or raise the glass alpha behind HUD stats to about 0.75.

ui.title: Card reveal hides the drone and the whole HUD for 6.5 s while flight continues at full speed
ui.evidence: r3g.mjs: Start, then hold W+R while the first reveal is up. After 2.5 s of sim the drone was at 223 km/h and had moved 132 m (pos -159,-4340 to -283,-4385). Meanwhile .hud-stats opacity was 0.039, the tutorial card opacity 0, and canvas#view filter brightness(0.646). Screenshot .review/ux-desktop/r3g-00-boost-during-reveal.png shows the card at x 520-760, y 130-670, covering the screen centre where the drone is, over a dimmed sky. card-reveal.ts closes only on 'Keep flying', panel:open or activity:start, or after 6500 ms (3000 ms per queued card), never on flight input. game.step zeroes input only when panels.openId is set. Discoveries fire just by flying close (190 discover activities), so this happens repeatedly in normal free flight, often at boost speed (Fort Mason fired mid-boost at sim 13.7 s in r3c). The queued focus/auto-close item and the fixed timed-activity item do not cover this.
ui.file_hint: src/ui/card-reveal.ts (setTimeout close, dismiss hooks); src/ui/ui.css:217-218 (.revealing hides .hud and dims canvas); src/game.ts step()
ui.fix_hint: For passive discoveries during free flight, show a compact non-dimming card in a corner that keeps the HUD visible. Or dismiss the reveal on any flight input. Or treat the reveal like an open panel (zero input, hover) so the drone cannot fly blind.

ui.title: F during tutorial steps 1-5 silently starts a hidden activity, and the HUD then gives two conflicting instructions
ui.evidence: r3f.mjs: fresh save, tutorial at 'Step 1 of 6: Fly forward'. The F prompt row is hidden by ui.css:135 (.hud:has(.onboard:not([data-step=activity])) .hud-prompt-row {display:none}), yet the nearby activity is 'Pitch Founders, Inc.'. Pressing F set active = pitch-founders-inc, toasted 'Pitch Founders, Inc.: go!' and set the status to 'Founders, Inc.: land on the glowing rooftop pad'. Screenshot r3f-02-pitch-3s.png shows that status at the top, the 'Fly forward / Hold W' tutorial card at the bottom and a 'Next 25 m' marker together. F is listed in Controls as 'Start the activity you are next to', so players will press it.
ui.fix_hint: Ignore 'interact' while the tutorial is on steps 1-5 (the prompt is hidden then anyway). Or show the prompt and let starting an activity jump the tutorial to its last step.

ui.title: Off-screen waypoint label is clipped at the screen edge, and activity targets are labelled only 'Next'
ui.evidence: r3d.mjs at Chapter 1 start: .wp-label rect is -21,476-201,515 with text 'Fly to the rotunda of the Palace of Fine Arts. / 1.7 km'. Screenshot r3d-01-chapter-started.png shows 'y to the rotunda of the Palace...' cut at the left edge. waypoint.ts places the edge marker with edgePoint(dx, dy, W/2 - 90, H/2 - 70), a 90 px margin, but the label can be 222 px wide (200 px text plus padding), so it overhangs by up to about 21 px. Separately, guideTarget() labels every active-activity target just 'Next' (r3f-02 'Next 25 m', r3d-03-obj1-near-hidden 'Next 100 m'). This is distinct from the queued dialogue/edge-label overlap item.
ui.file_hint: src/ui/waypoint.ts:22 (label 'Next') and the edgePoint margins near line 88; src/ui/ui.css:55-56
ui.fix_hint: Clamp the edge position by max(90, label.offsetWidth/2 + 8) horizontally, or clamp the label's own translateX within the viewport. Use the activity or objective title instead of 'Next'.

ui.title: Touch players cannot fly, turn or change altitude while the photo viewfinder is open, but 29 photo activities need exactly that
ui.evidence: ui.css:219 hides .touch-ui (both sticks and the up, down, BOOST and F buttons) under .vf-open. Flight input itself is not gated: nothing in src/player or core/input checks the viewfinder, so keyboard players can still steer. s13-vfstick.mjs on the phone, photo-sutro-tower-above-the-fog: dragging the move stick with the viewfinder closed gives a touch axis of 0.19. With it open, elementFromPoint at the stick centre returns 'vf-bar' and the axis stays 0.00. The viewfinder only offers close, tilt up, shutter, tilt down and album (s12-photo.mjs). Its checklist (photo-vf.png) asks for Distance, Altitude and Centered ('23° off center'), and all three need the drone to move or turn. A touch player has to close the viewfinder, nudge, reopen and recheck, over and over.
ui.fix_hint: Keep the sticks visible under .vf-open on touch (hide only the up, down, BOOST and F row), or let a drag on the viewfinder frame yaw the drone the way the wheel tilts it.

ui.title: F button glows 'ready' during tutorial steps 1 to 5 with the prompt hidden; tapping it silently starts a VC pitch
ui.evidence: s7-land.mjs, a real player with no ?test on a phone at 844x390 (the same happens at 390x844 and on iPad, see phone-flying.png and ipadp-hud.png). At spawn, .tbtn-act has class 'ready' (bright yellow) and the tutorial reads 'Step 1 of 6 Fly forward'. ui.css:135 hides .hud-prompt-row for every step except 'activity', so nothing says what F will do. One tap on F gives the toast 'Pitch Founders, Inc.: go!' and the status 'Founders, Inc.: land on the glowing rooftop pad', while the card still says 'Step 1 of 6 Fly forward' (phonel-after-f.png). The brightest control on screen starts the VC pitch that an earlier round had moved out of the new-player path.
ui.fix_hint: Apply the same tutorial rule to the touch F button: no 'ready' glow, and interact() does nothing, until the onboarding step is 'activity' or the tutorial is skipped.

ui.title: On phones the tour card covers the up, down, BOOST and F buttons and the top half of both sticks for the whole tour
ui.evidence: s5-acts.mjs on the phone (390x844) with tour-mission-murals: the .tour card spans 16,568 to 374,752. It overlaps tbtn-up, tbtn-down, tbtn-boost and tbtn-act (52x52 each) and the top 52 px of both sticks. phone-act-tour.png shows the buttons faded under the card text. The cause is the phone override at places.css:101, which pins .tour to bottom: safe-area + 76px; that offset was written for the desktop prompt. The card has pointer-events: none, so taps on its text hit invisible buttons. This affects all 21 tours, which are 6-stop flights where climb and boost are needed.
ui.fix_hint: Under .touch at max-width 640px, place the tour card above .touch-buttons (bottom: var(--bottom) + 230px or similar), or put it at the top under the status pill.

ui.title: Phone HUD collisions: toasts sit under the tutorial card, the menubar and the viewfinder readout; in landscape the tutorial card covers the battery and the status pill
ui.evidence: Portrait 390x844 (tut-step6.png): the toast 'Waypoint set: Initial Commit' renders behind the step 6 tutorial card and overlaps its 'then tap F' line. .touch .toasts is at --top+292px (ui.css:230), inside .touch .onboard at --top+100px (ui.css:159). Landscape 844x390 (phonel-after-f.png): .touch .toasts is at --top+8px (ui.css:255), so 'Pitch Founders, Inc.: go!' is drawn behind the menubar icons. The tutorial card also overlaps the battery pill by 12x33 px (s4-hud.mjs on the rotated Pixel 7) and hides the 'Founders, Inc.: land on...' status pill. Viewfinder in portrait (photo-vf.png): the two toasts and the 'Next 750 m' waypoint label print over the 'VIEWFINDER TILT -7° ALT 241 m Sutro Tower' readout, and none of it can be read.
ui.fix_hint: Give toasts one slot that avoids the onboarding card and the menubar (for example, stack them right under the onboarding card when it exists, or move them to the lower third above the touch buttons), and hide or relocate toasts under .vf-open.

ui.title: On phones the status pill truncates the countdown, so timed photo and trivia activities hide their clock
ui.evidence: ui.css:226 sets .touch .hud-status { max-width: calc(100vw - 124px) } with ellipsis, which is 266 px at 390 wide. Photo builds its status as `📷 ${name} · ${dist} · ${clock}` (photo.ts:172), and on the phone it shows '📷 Sutro Tower · 782 m · 3…' (phone-act-photo.png, photo-vf.png). Trivia builds `${title}  ${secs}s` (trivia.ts:66) and shows 'Golden Gate Bridge Trivia …' (phone-act2-trivia.png). The tour shows 'Mission Murals and Sweets …' and Chapter 1 shows 'Chapter 1 · Initial Commit…'. The part that changes, the timer, is the part cut off.
ui.fix_hint: Let the pill wrap to two lines on touch, or render the clock in its own fixed span that is never ellipsised, and truncate only the title.

ui.title: Move my progress on a phone: tapping Send shows the code off-screen, and the feature is only reachable from the bottom of Friends
ui.evidence: The sync itself works (s3-sync.mjs, real Nostr relays, phone and iPad in separate contexts). Phone to iPad merged in 1.7 s and iPad to phone in 0.5 s. Both ended with 12 completions, 3 cards, 12 medals and 990 XP, persisted to localStorage. On the phone (s9-friends.mjs), after scrolling to and tapping 'Send from this device', the code box .fr-roomcode lands at y 869 to 904 while the viewport ends at 844. Nothing visibly changes and there is no auto-scroll (phone-sync-code.png). grep finds no mention of moving progress in settings.ts, menu.ts or help.ts, so a player looking under Settings will not find it.
ui.fix_hint: After offer() succeeds, call codeBox.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}), and add a 'Move progress to another device' row in Settings or Menu that opens Friends scrolled to .fr-sync.

ui.title: The drone colour picker uses different palettes on the title screen and in Friends; a colour picked at the title shows no selection in Friends
ui.evidence: settings-model.ts:51 DRONE_COLORS (title and Settings): #f2f2ee, #ff6a3d, #ffc15e, #7de0a6, #5fb4ff, #b48cff, #ff7eb6, #2b2f36. friends.ts:12 SWATCHES: the same first four and #ff7eb6, but #5ec8ff, #9b8cff and #ff4d5e in place of the blue, purple and charcoal. s9-friends.mjs: tapping blue on the title saved droneColor #5fb4ff. Then every Friends swatch reports aria-pressed=false, and Friends shows a near-identical blue that is not selected. Charcoal exists only on the title; red exists only in Friends.
ui.fix_hint: Delete SWATCHES in friends.ts and import DRONE_COLORS.

ui.title: On phones the waypoint edge label runs off the left screen edge
ui.evidence: s6-quest.mjs, phone 390x844, after starting Chapter 1 by touch (quest-after-dialogue.png): the off-screen waypoint label at the left edge reads 'y to the rotunda of the Palace...' with '1.7 km'. The opening 'Fl' of the objective sits past x=0, so the label is clipped instead of clamped inside the viewport.
ui.fix_hint: Clamp the edge label's left and right to a 12 px gutter, and cap its width at about 60vw with an ellipsis.

ui.title: Collection category tabs are cut off mid-chip at 1280 px with no scroll affordance
ui.evidence: Collection at 1280x800 with all cards owned: the tab row shows 7 of 12 categories and ends in a half-visible chip (only its icon) at the right edge (c/dex_history.png). After scrolling to Companies, the first chip is clipped at the left edge (c/dex_companies.png). Companies, Tech, Transit, Events and Hidden SF are hidden with no fade, arrow or wrap. This is on desktop and in the Collection, separate from the queued phone-menubar item.
ui.fix_hint: Wrap the chips onto two rows on desktop, or add an edge fade mask plus scroll-snap so the cut-off is clearly a scroller.

map.title: Map markers render above the zoom and centre buttons; tapping Zoom out opens a place popup instead
map.evidence: s11-maptools.mjs, phone landscape 844x390, map opened at spawn. elementFromPoint at the centre of 'Zoom out' (750,199) returns BUTTON.map-marker 'In-N-Out Burger, Fisherman's Wharf'. At the centre of 'Center on my drone' it returns the locked marker 'In-N-Out Burger, Fisherman's Wharf Trivia'. Tapping Zoom out left the scale at '200 m' and opened the In-N-Out popup with Set waypoint and Close (phonel-maptools.png). The tool column's parent has z-index 1 on one button and auto on the others, so markers paint over them. Separate from the queued marker-to-marker overlap: here the map's own controls are unusable.
map.fix_hint: Give the map tool column a z-index above the marker layer, or inset the marker layer so markers never render under the tool column.

world.title: Salesforce Tower, Transamerica Pyramid and the 38 hand-built skyline towers go black or flat gray at night
world.evidence: Night shots (clockOffset +9 h) from the Embarcadero and downtown viewpoints: the financial district core shows as windowless black slabs and flat gray boxes, while low-rise blocks around them are lit (.review/visual/r3/b/night_downtown.png, b/night_embarcadero.png, b/crop_nd_center.png). The Salesforce Tower body is pure black under its crown. Probe: hiding the 3 meshes that use cityRenderer.material without an aInfo attribute (2308 triangles) removes exactly those slabs and the Salesforce and Transamerica bodies (c/night_downtown_all.png vs c/night_downtown_kit_hidden.png, mask c/diff.png, overlay c/xa.png). Root cause: landmark-kit.ts:255-258 windows() only tints the geometry and never sets aInfo, so in city-shader.ts the seed s = vInfo.z/15 = 0. Then avgC = ... * step(0.15, fract(s*2.9)) = 0 (line 89), so once windows fade to their average (wfade toward 1, from a few hundred meters) the emission avgWin*litFrac*avgC is 0. Every kit tower also shares the same 22% lit pattern up close. Users: salesforce-tower.ts:46, transamerica-pyramid.ts:50 and :79, skyline-modern.ts:94 (38 towers).
world.fix_hint: In Site.windows(), write an aInfo attribute (base height, class 2 or 3 for towers, a per-tower seed from hash(name)) like city.ts:53 does, so kit towers get a nonzero seed, distance glow and varied lit floors.

world.title: The world ends at the data bounds: the Bay Bridge stops mid-bay and the East Bay, Angel Island and Sausalito are open ocean
world.evidence: From Yerba Buena Island looking east (c/baybridge_east_end2.png), the new east span ends just past its single tower and the deck stops over open water, which runs flat to the horizon: no Oakland, no port, no Berkeley hills. Looking north past Alcatraz (a/noon_alcatraz.png) there is no Angel Island, Tiburon or Sausalito. From Twin Peaks at dawn (b/dawn_twinpeaks.png) the sun rises over flat sea where the East Bay hills should be. geo.ts:3 BOUNDS north 37.84, east -122.33. Terrain and the bridge model (bay-bridge.ts SAS_EAST at -122.3547) stop there, and surfaceAt 500 m past the east bound returns 0.
world.fix_hint: Add a cheap, non-collidable backdrop ring: low-res silhouettes of Marin, Angel Island and the East Bay hills (z10 terrain tiles, or hand-made low-poly), fogged, plus the Bay Bridge skyway to a landfall. It reads as SF Bay without loading more city.

world.title: Commit tower name tags are depth-tested sprites: buildings slice through the text, and beyond about 1 km they become blank dark rectangles
world.evidence: Salesforce viewpoint at noon: the 'Wikimedia F...n' tag has the Salesforce Tower cutting through its middle, the 'Re...' and 'Doc...n' tags are cut by a nearer tower, and a 'Y...' tag is clipped at the screen edge under the menubar (a/crop_sf_labels.png, same at night in b/night_salesforce.png). From Twin Peaks the tags show as small dark boxes floating over the skyline with no readable text (a/crop_tp_sky.png). commit-towers.ts:86 creates a SpriteMaterial with default depthTest. Lines 243-260 show labels up to LABEL_RANGE=1800 m with scale capped at 1.8, which leaves about 8 px tall text, and accept positions up to |ndc|=1.2 (off screen).
world.fix_hint: Set depthTest false (or hide a tag when its anchor fails a depth or raycast test), cap the range where the text is still at least 12 px (about 600 m), and require |ndc| < 0.9 so tags never sit under the menubar.

world.title: Inland lakes are painted ground, not water: the Palace of Fine Arts lagoon is a flat teal decal that ignores the sunset
world.evidence: Noon: the Palace of Fine Arts lagoon is a flat, unlit dark teal shape with a scalloped outline, a different material from the shimmering bay behind it (a/crop_palace.png). Sunset: the bay reflects the pink sky while the lagoon stays the same flat teal (a/sunset_palace.png). Golden Gate Park lakes show the same flat fill (a/noon_ggpark.png). landcover.ts:115-119 mixes the constant vec3(0.2,0.36,0.42) into the terrain base color by the landcover alpha. The lake never gets the water shader (reflection, sun glint, foam).
world.fix_hint: Build the OSM lake polygons from green.bin as flat meshes a few cm above the terrain using the existing water material (no foam, low wave amplitude), so lakes match the bay at every time of day.

world.title: Embarcadero piers render as rounded sandbars with surf rims instead of flat decks
world.evidence: From the water east of Piers 1 to 5 at 18 m (c/piers_low.png) and from the Embarcadero viewpoint (a/crop_emb_spit.png), each pier is a smooth gray ramp sloping into the water with no vertical edge. The pier sheds sit on top of the ramp and overhang it. A white foam line traces the tip of a pier, because water.ts:110-111 draws foam wherever depth is under 1.4 m and the 16 m terrain grid turns each pier into a shallow slope. This is distinct from the earlier sand-colour report: the colour is now gray, but the shape and surf remain.
world.fix_hint: Flatten or carve the heightmap under pier footprints to just below water, and draw piers as extruded deck polygons with vertical edges and dark piling bands. Mask foam inside a pier-footprint buffer.

world.title: Plane nav lights draw as hard, unfogged square pixels floating in the daytime sky and through fog
world.evidence: From Twin Peaks a lone red 7 px square hangs in the empty sky at noon and sunset, with no plane visible around it (a/crop_tp_red.png, a/crop_stp_red.png). At night inside the fog off Alcatraz a white square stays at full brightness while everything else is fogged out (b/night_alcatraz.png at 1098,140). live-planes.ts:22-25 uses PointsMaterial with sizeAttenuation false, fog false and no round texture, so each light is a fixed-size square that outlives the fogged plane body.

world.title: Water ripples turn into streaks toward the horizon
world.evidence: Magnified horizon looking north from off Alcatraz at noon: the far water is a dense pattern of horizontal streaks right up to the horizon line instead of resolving to a calm sheen (a/crop_alc_horizon.png; also visible behind downtown in a/crop_tp_sky.png). water.ts:70 always adds the wGrad(p*0.045) octave at strength 0.22 with no distance fade. Only the finer octaves fade (lines 71-73). At grazing angles over kilometres its wavelength drops below a pixel and aliases, which crawls in motion.
world.fix_hint: Fade the 0.045 octave too (for example 1 - smoothstep(1500, 5000, dist)) and lean on the long-wave cosines plus fresnel for distant water.

buildings.title: 81% of cards reuse one art template per category: all 46 companies get the same window grid and all 30 history cards the same compass
buildings.evidence: Collection with every card owned: the History tab shows Emperor Norton, 1939 World's Fair, April 18 1906, Bloody Thursday, Carville-by-the-Sea, El Presidio, First Cable Car, Portsmouth Square and others with an identical compass-rose picture (c/dex_history.png). The Companies tab shows Airbnb, Andreessen Horowitz, Anthropic, GitHub, Lucasfilm, OpenAI, Salesforce, Stripe, Twitter and Y Combinator as the same 6x4 window grid (c/dex_companies.png); the first-card reveal shows the same grid for Founders, Inc. (b/night_goldengate.png). Counting src/content/cards: 228 cards, only 43 with custom art (28 landmark, 15 wildlife). Generic: company 46, history 30, park 25, hidden 21, food 20, transit 16, culture 13, tech 12, event 2. card-art.ts MOTIFS gives one motif per category; only lit cells and gradient angle vary.
buildings.fix_hint: Give every card an art key and add motifs: an HQ silhouette or building shape for companies (not a logo), dish shapes for food, scene vignettes for history. At minimum, make the category motif parametric on the card's own data (neighborhood, year, a defining object) so no two cards in a tab look alike.
